heading: Remedies as cumulative
lead: Except as otherwise provided in this part, the remedies provided under this part are in addition to remedies existing under another law or common law.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 10103 of this title prior to the general amendment of this subtitle by Pub. L. 104–88, § 102(a).

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Jan. 1, 1996, except as otherwise provided in Pub. L. 104–88, see section 2 of Pub. L. 104–88, set out as a note under section 1301 of this title.
